selectionBasis: capability catalog §6 base row S09 is the last undefined base scenario of the accessibility family; roadmap §9 M3 assigns the network candidates (P5 solve_routes, calculate_service_areas) to this exit, and catalog §10 binds the routing sub-cases of X37/X38 to TP04. M2 calibrated TP04 on a qualified frozen isochrone input; M3 states the tool-facing assertions and their blocked precondition.

selectionBasis: catalog §6 base row S14; roadmap §9 M3 assigns the raster family (P6) to this exit and catalog §10 routes terrain and hydrology panels to TS07. The six hydrology algorithms are named entries in the frozen 53-name whitelist, so this is the M3 family whose path is nameable today without touching the whitelist.

inputFixtures.role: floating-point surface raster used as the elevation-type reference
inputFixtures.qualification: structural schema and row counts verified from the read-only fixture inventory; cartographic gold result not present

inputFixtures.qualification: structural schema and row counts verified from the read-only fixture inventory; cartographic gold result not present

inputProfiles.variation: A declared surface raster with units and Z datum, one pour point set and a stated flow method; accumulation, direction and watershed outputs bind to one grid.
Multiple pour points on a shared trunk with a flat area; accumulation monotonicity is preserved and flat-area handling is stated instead of guessed.
A surface raster without declared units or Z datum, or a pour point outside the accumulation extent; refused before writing.

expectedOutputs: Terrain and hydrology panel set on one common grid with Z datum and units declared
Machine-readable derivation report naming each admitted algorithm
Alignment receipt proving panel grids are identical (ALN-001)
Machine-readable validation report and artifact manifest
